answers.core: Implementing this LOD system in C++ would lead to better performance when using large amounts of particle nodes (hundreds or more).
answers.workaround: Kind of. It's possible to toggle particle emission in a script. The [Godot LOD](https://github.com/godot-extended-libraries/godot-lod) add-on I wrote provides such a feature.

title: Add a level of detail system for GPUParticles3D and CPUParticles3D
